origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends): a function named server.run_shell_command:v2, as an MCP server names the tools it adds (Gemini takes dots and colons up to 128 characters); an upstream of another vendor takes letters, digits, _ and - only, so the relay is left out as a conversion it cannot serve and Kiro answers. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
